action: ShebaMiles members: change your password (and reuse nowhere else), watch the account for unusual activity, and treat unexpected emails about it as possible phishing.
date_note: Date of the airline's customer notice; the intrusion date was not stated.
exec: A national airline has told frequent-flyer customers their data may be exposed; passenger loyalty data is a ready phishing source.
plain: Ethiopian Airlines told customers of its ShebaMiles frequent-flyer programme that some of their data may have been exposed in a cyber incident. It says it has no evidence that financial information was accessed.
summary: Ethiopian Airlines notified customers of a cybersecurity incident affecting its ShebaMiles frequent-flyer programme. Capital Ethiopia quotes the notice as describing a limited-scope incident and saying there is currently no evidence financial information was accessed; Fidel Post describes it as targeted and localized. The airline has not said how many accounts or which data types were affected, or when it was detected.
title: Ethiopian Airlines reports ShebaMiles frequent-flyer data incident

validation.note: Airline customer notice reported by Capital Ethiopia and Fidel Post; number affected and data types not disclosed. TechCabal page (403) not read.
